'''Colla-Arphoc Automata''' was a company put out of business by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] long before [[43 ABY]]. [[Lestra Oxic]] sought to reform Colla-Arphoc Automata claiming the possession of documents proving that the company's dissolution had been only for a limited term and had expired in [[42 ABY]].
